name: answering a grammar point correctly does not mark it introduced
description: `introduced` is what the composer reads to decide whether a lesson must teach a point before drilling it, so only an explicit `introduced` event — the shell's grammar reference page being dismissed — may set it. Attempts must not, because any item can carry a grammar tag: a passage authored for another lesson, or a comprehension question that inherits its parent's evidence. When attempts counted as teaching, a café reading pulled into the hotel lesson marked `vorrei` introduced, and the bar lesson — whose entire premise is `vorrei` — then composed with no grammar card at all and the learner was never told the rule. gp_a here is attempted four times and reaches real mastery while staying untaught; gp_b is taught and never practised.
